title: mopm index config (/index/config.json)
description: Read first by the CLI. A CLI that does not know index_version refuses the index.

index_versions.description: Every index version served, sorted. When absent it is [index_version]. A client that reads version 2 refuses a registry whose list lacks 2.

api_url.description: https API root ending in /api/v1, or loopback http (127.0.0.1, [::1], localhost, port required) for local and test registries only.

api_v2_url.description: The API root of version 2, ending in /api/v2, on the rules of api_url.

channel_url.description: Base URL ending in '/'; a namespace's channel is channel_url followed by <namespace>/. https conda.<host>, or loopback http (port required, any path) for local and test registries only.
